notes: REF-BM-02: collects title/description/favicon but no preview image (og:image only used as icon fallback, not stored as a separate preview). REF-BM-03: title/description editable only after saving via edit form; on create these fields are hidden (edit-only), so no pre-save editing. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags editable but there is no note field to edit. REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/url/tags but note is not a facet (no notes exist). REF-BM-14: no #tag search syntax; search is plain substring over a combined haystack. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised boolean parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag, no unread-only view, no read toggle. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: list is fixed created_at DESC with no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: no markdown note field or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive flag, no archive/delete distinction, no archived-only view. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no user settings (sort/displayed items/font size); font-size appears only as static CSS.
